text: A student shall register for not fewer than 15 and not more than 27 credits in any regular semester, except in the final semester of the programme.
source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE rule used only to exercise the rule chunker

text: A student may register for a Minor only on obtaining a CGPA of 7.00 or above at the end of the second semester, and must complete the prescribed credits of the Minor to have it recorded on the transcript.
A student shall not register for a course unless all courses listed as its hard prerequisites have been completed with a passing grade. The instructor may waive a recommended prerequisite in writing.

Credit earned through an approved NPTEL or SWAYAM course may be counted towards elective requirements up to a stated ceiling, subject to prior approval by the Department and the Senate-approved equivalence list.
